cancelBooking.title: Cancel booking
cancelBooking.intro: Enter your booking code. We will send a secure, time-limited cancellation link to the email address recorded on the booking.
cancelBooking.generic: If a booking with the specified code exists, a cancellation link has been sent to the email address recorded on the booking.
cancelBooking.genericInstruction: The booking is not cancelled yet — open the secure link in the email and press “Confirm cancellation”.
cancelBooking.expiredLink: This cancellation link has expired. Request a new link.
cancelBooking.usedLink: This cancellation link has already been used.
cancelBooking.closed: This booking can no longer be cancelled online.
cancelBooking.policyFree: Free cancellation is available until the scheduled pickup time. No cancellation fee applies.
cancelBooking.successCopy: The booking has been cancelled. Confirmation emails were sent to you and GeoRentalCars.
cancelBooking.emailInstruction: To cancel, open the secure link below and confirm cancellation. The link is temporary and can be used only once.
cancelBooking.changeInstruction: To change the vehicle, dates, times or locations, cancel this booking and create a new one.
cancelBooking.requestEmailLine: Use the secure button below to review the booking and confirm cancellation.
cancelBooking.cancelledEmailLine: Your booking was cancelled through the secure self-service cancellation page.
